p.write_text('[\n{"step":1,"file":"init.c","function":"__parse_jobs_ini","line":1896,"var":"p","code":"opts[num_opts] = strdup(p);","note":"An INI line such as description=$ncpus is copied from the job file into a heap buffer, preserving the attacker-controlled keyword text."},\n{"step":2,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_options_parse","line":5195,"var":"opts_copy","code":"opts_copy = dup_and_sub_options(opts, num_opts);","note":"The parser duplicates each option string and passes it to keyword substitution before normal option parsing."},\n{"step":3,"file":"options.c","function":"dup_and_sub_options","line":5148,"var":"opts_copy[i]","code":"opts_copy[i] = fio_option_dup_subs(opts[i]);","note":"The duplicated option reaches fio_keyword_replace through fio_option_dup_subs, so the attacker-controlled substring is processed by the keyword expander."},\n{"step":4,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5101,"var":"s","code":"while ((s = strstr(opt, kw->word)) != NULL) {","note":"The code finds the $ncpus keyword inside the option string and prepares to build a replacement string around it."},\n{"step":5,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5115,"var":"opt","code":"opt += strlen(kw->word) + olen;","note":"When the keyword is not at the start of the string, opt is advanced past the later match location, so the following copy uses the wrong base pointer."},\n{"step":6,"file":"options.c","function":"fio_keyword_replace","line":5119,"var":"memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","code":"if (strlen(opt)) memcpy(new + olen + len, opt, opt - o_org - 1);","note":"The copy length is computed from the advanced opt pointer instead of the original string tail length, causing a heap-buffer-overflow during keyword substitution."}\n]')
print(p.read_text())
